title: [Soup´s] Lavander Snow
body:
This respack aims to desaturate the snow textures; much like Vanilla Tweaks. However, it aswell gives the respack a lavander-purple-ish flare to it, giving it almost an magical or night-themed aesthetic to it.

This resource pack is heavily inspired by Vanilla Tweaks desaturated snow ^˘^ https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/.
